upcoming.name: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake

resident-evil-veronica.name: Resident Evil Veronica
resident-evil-veronica.description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

titan-quest-2.name: Titan Quest 2
titan-quest-2.description: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

dreams.description: Dream anything, play everything Create, play and share your own games and experiences, in the incredible new title from the LittleBigPlanet and Tearaway team. Dreams is an extraordinary open-ended experience where you can make anything, from interactive adventures and platformers, to shoot ‘em ups, puzzlers and more. The possibilities are endless.
dreams.name: Dreams

the-witcher-remake.name: The Witcher: Remake
the-witcher-remake.description: The Witcher Remake is what you might know by the codename “Canis Majoris”. It’s still early and we want to ensure that the game is created with the utmost care and attention to detail, therefore, while we’re excited to share the news with you, we want to ask you for patience as it will be a while until we start talking about this project in detail.

kena-scars-of-kosmora.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
kena-scars-of-kosmora.description: In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, Kena is older and renowned as a Spirit Guide. In hopes of finding answers to the affliction she has endured all her life, Kena travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Home to distinct cultures and regions, Kosmora is full of buried secrets from a tragic past.

marvels-spider-man-3.name: Marvel's Spider-Man 3
marvels-spider-man-3.description: Marvel’s Spider-Man 3 is currently in development by Insomniac Games for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 6. Created in collaboration with Marvel Games and PlayStation.

ananta.name: ananta
ananta.description: Previously known as Project Mugen, ANANTA is a free-to-play urban open-world RPG set in Nova City. Players become the new captain of a special task force, switch between different characters and roles, fight hidden threats, and freely explore a living city filled with activities, vehicles, and unexpected events. Launches globally on January 15, 2027 for PC, PlayStation 5, iOS, and Android.

fable2020.name: Fable
fable2020.description: Explore a land of fantastical creatures and wondrous places. What does it mean to be a Hero? Well, in the fairytale land of Albion, that is entirely up to you. With a dark threat looming, your choices will change Albion forever.

the-expanse-osiris-reborn.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
the-expanse-osiris-reborn.description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in the world of The Expanse. You are not a hero, but a simple mercenary who found himself in the wrong place at the wrong time. Assemble a team, break through the web of lies and leave your mark on the history of the solar system.

no-rest-for-the-wicked-2024.name: No Rest for the Wicked
no-rest-for-the-wicked-2024.description: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre. The year is 841 – King Harol is dead. As word of his death echoes throughout the kingdom, the crown passes to his arrogant, yet untested son Magnus.

the-witcher-4.name: The Witcher (A New Saga Begins)
the-witcher-4.description: The Witcher IV is a single-player, open-world RPG from CD PROJEKT RED. At the start of a new saga, players take on the role of Ciri, a professional monster slayer, and embark on a journey through a brutal dark-fantasy world. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, it aims to be the most immersive and ambitious open-world Witcher game to date.

ratchet-clank-rift-apart.description: BLAST YOUR WAY THROUGH AN INTERDIMENSIONAL ADVENTURE The intergalactic adventurers are back with a bang. Help them stop a robotic emperor intent on conquering cross-dimensional worlds, with their own universe next in the firing line. - Blast your way home with an arsenal of outrageous weaponry. - Experience the shuffle of dimensional rifts and dynamic gameplay.
ratchet-clank-rift-apart.name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart

owlboy.description: Owlboy is a pixel-art platformer game about an owl-humanoid boy called Otus. When his homeland was attacked by pirates, Otus starts an adventure to protect his home and reveal the secrets of his race. He makes new friends on the way. Each of them has special powers, useful during fights.
owlboy.name: Owlboy

dark-souls-ii.description: Dark Souls II is the third installment in the well-known Souls series. It’s a different game from all the others because of its directors. With Dark Souls II the main director and founder of Souls-like genre Hidetaka Miyazaki took place only as a supervisor of the project, leaving a place of the director of the game for two young video game designers Tomohiro Shibuya and Yui Tanimura.
dark-souls-ii.name: Dark Souls II

phantom-blade-zero.name: Phantom Blade Zero
phantom-blade-zero.description: Be the Dark Raider exiled by "The Order", embark on the path of vengeance, and uncover the darkest secrets of Wulin!

shadows-die-twice.description: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is a game about a ninja (or shinobi, as they call it), who is seeking revenge in the Sengoku era Japan. ###Plot
shadows-die-twice.name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice

marvels-venom.name: Marvel's Venom
marvels-venom.description: Marvel’s Venom is currently in development by Insomniac Games for PlayStation 5. Created in collaboration with Marvel Games and PlayStation.

9-years-of-shadows.description: 9 Years of Shadows is an emotionally-driven metroidvania enhanced by healing music that tells the story of Europa, a young woman of noble birth tasked with ending the curse that plagues her people and restoring color to all lands. Immersive gameplay
9-years-of-shadows.name: 9 Years of Shadows

prince-of-persia-the-sands-of-time-remak.name: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake
prince-of-persia-the-sands-of-time-remak.description: The Prince has returned! Experience the classic tale that redefined action-adventure gaming in this full-scale remake for a new generation. - You are the Prince of Persia. Embark on a journey to save your kingdom from the treacherous Vizier. - Master the Sands of Time and use your dagger to reverse, accelerate, freeze, and slow time itself. - Fight cursed enemies and solve puzzles along the way.

tomb-raider-catalyst.name: Tomb Raider: Catalyst
tomb-raider-catalyst.description: Tomb Raider: Catalyst marks a bold direction for the series as Lara Croft embarks on a new adventure across Northern India. Tomb Raider: Catalyst is set in the wake of a mythical cataclysm that has unleashed ancient secrets and awakened the mysterious forces that guard them.

brothers-a-tale-of-two-sons-2.description: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons is a story about teamwork. Having a very curious setup, the story follows two brothers on a quest. With their mother dead and father being heavily ill, the only way to save is to bring water from the Tree of Life. But on their way, they will have to challenge the world and themselves. Villages, mountains and forests, bullies, trolls and wolves will await Naiee and Naia on their journey.
brothers-a-tale-of-two-sons-2.name: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons
